FONT = "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" # Deloitte palette: black, Deloitte green (accents only; too light for text), cool grays, accessible link blue. BLACK = "#000000" GREEN = "#86BC25" GRAY_TEXT = "#53565A" GRAY_LINE = "#D0D0CE" GRAY_FILL = "#F2F2F2" BLUE = "#0076A8" # Outlook ignores most stylesheet CSS, so every element gets inline styles.
